title: Referral share
description: Full-viewport referral screen composing the share-invite block: invite friends by email, copy the referral link or send it to a channel, see who has joined, and how the reward works, with the block's loading, error and empty states. Presentational — data and callbacks in, no navigation state — and responsive to its container (@container) across the @sm and @md contract steps: the masthead lines up at @sm; the title grows, the steps sit side by side and the footer lines up at @md.
